Introduction

Koko is a Japanese trainee. She is a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.

Prior to her participation on the show, Koko was a contestant in FNC Entertainment Japan and Nippon TV's survival show Who Is Princess?, where she was eliminated in episode 10.
